Initial release of drt-self-improving-agent:

- Journals every trade with detailed fields and auto-builds a trade memory (`trades.json`)
- Analyzes win/loss patterns by setup, bias, R:R, killzone, etc., and summarizes actionable learning points
- Adjusts agent trading rules based on real data, not gut feeling
- Includes killzone reminders and rule-based trade gating (e.g., max trades per day, always use SL)
- Premium: supports live signal fetches from x402-API (optional), configurable via environment
- Easy CLI commands for journaling, analysis, and API signals
